subject: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erikson <t.erikson@acme-corp.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-05T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path

Hi Tom / Rebecca — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can map the procurement path and hit your target timeline.

Demo notes (brief)
- Showed throughput/latency profiles and Dedicated plan options (2x V100 equiv).
- Discussed enterprise controls: VPC Private, KMS integration, audit logs retention.
- Pricing ballpark shown: reserved capacity + per-token adjustments; final will be in SOW.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the buying committee and the economic decision owner? (we heard Daniel Park may sign off on spend)
2) Who owns vendor onboarding / PO processing (email or portal)? Is procurement@acme-corp.com the inbox?
3) Any specific invoice terms (PO required, net30/45, vendor registration portal)?
4) Security/legal: Rebecca — are you the right person for DPA/SOC2 review or should we include someone else?

Attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page), redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (vendor info we typically need). If you can drop the names/emails and a target PO date, I’ll circulate a short mutual action plan and send an SOW draft.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- PO submitted by Apr 13 -> onboarding week of Apr 20 -> production test by May 4

Thanks — I’m happy to jump on a 15-min sync with procurement/legal to close the onboarding questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0183
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx]

From: Tom Erikson <t.erikson@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme-corp.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-04-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path

Thanks Vanessa — useful recap. Quick answers: 
- Economic buyer: Daniel Park, CFO (daniel.park@acme-corp.com). He approves line-item spends over $50k.
- Procurement: procurement@acme-corp.com is correct; procurement portal exists but for faster turnaround they prefer vendor email + PO PDF.
- Legal/Security: Rebecca is primary for contracts/DPA, but she will loop in IT security if we need deeper controls review.
- Invoice terms: Acme standard is PO required, Net30. Finance team needs vendor tax id + W-9 equivalent (US).

Action items from our side: I’ll confirm whether Daniel wants a one-pager ROI note before sign-off and we’ll surface a PO date after procurement checks your vendor onboarding checklist. Expect procurement to kick back a standard vendor form to fill out.

Tom
Head of Product Partnerships, Acme Corporation
[t.erikson@acme-corp.com]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erikson <t.erikson@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path

Thanks Tom — copying procurement as requested. 

Attached: SOW-draft-v1.docx (pricing + scope), and I re-attached the onboarding checklist for form fields we typically see. Short answers inline:
- Billing contact (suggested): Acme Finance <procurement@acme-corp.com>; we can invoice to the entity listed on the PO.
- Tax info: we’ll attach Redwood W-9 and vendor tax details once procurement confirms the vendor registration portal or email path.
- Payment terms: SOW priced on a monthly reserved capacity cadence; invoice net30 unless you need net45 (let us know).

If procurement prefers a completed vendor registration PDF, point me to the form and we’ll fill it out this afternoon. If Daniel (CFO) wants an ROI one-pager, we can produce a 1-page summary tailored to how Redwood reduces per-token costs vs. self-hosted.

Proposed operational step: procurement sends PO -> we return completed vendor form + vendor tax docs -> signed SOW/DocuSign -> onboarding kickoff. If procurement confirms PO date by Apr 13 we can target onboarding the week of Apr 20.

Thanks — I’ll stand by for the vendor form.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft-v1.docx]
[Attachment: redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx]

From: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Tom Erikson <t.erikson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-04-07T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path

Vanessa — thanks for the SOW, I looked through the draft. A few quick legal/security items: 
- Please send our DPA template back with Redwood's proposed edits (we prefer starting from our DPA).
- We need the SOC2 Type II report or a SOC2 readiness summary; the one-page PDF you attached is helpful but security will want the report or an auditor attestation.
- Can you confirm data retention controls (retention period, deletion flow) and whether logs/audit trails are available for 12 months?

Procurement: we will send the vendor registration PDF this afternoon. It asks for vendor tax id, remittance address, and bank details for ACH. Vanessa, please assign someone internal to complete it.

Last: please include a contact in Redwood who will be the escalation point for any PII incidents (name, title, email).

Rebecca Lin
Senior Counsel, Acme Corporation
[Attachment: acme-vendor-registration.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, Tom Erikson <t.erikson@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: buying committee map + PO/invoice path

Rebecca / Procurement team — thanks for the quick review and for sending the registration form. I’ll coordinate the responses from Redwood and assign our security lead to provide the SOC2 paperwork and audit contact. Quick items from our side: 
- Redwood escalation contact: Priya Natarajan, Head of Security Operations (priya.natarajan@redwood.com). She will follow up with your security team for any controls/QoS questions.
- SOC2: we can provide the Type II report (redacted) under an NDA or a secure link. Vanessa will send the link today.
- Vendor tax id / W-9: attached in this thread (we will also fill your PDF).

Timeline sync: if Acme can issue a PO by Apr 13 we can complete vendor registration and sign the SOW within 3 business days and target onboarding week of Apr 20. I’ll create a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and share the link.

Next immediate actions:
1) Procurement sends completed vendor registration to vanessa.
2) Vanessa will send SOC2 secure link + Redwood W-9.
3) We’ll post SOW to DocuSign (link) once vendor form is in.

Thanks — I’ll be the internal owner for timing.

— Rishi Malhotra
Account Team Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-w9.pdf]
